Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-emudhra-info-ScS22A1r?vs_f=Cisco%20Security%20Advisory%26vs_cat=Security%20Intelligence%26vs_type=RSS%26vs_p=Cisco%20Informational%20for%20Emergency%20Distrust%20of%20eMudhra%20Root%20and%20Intermediate%20Certificate%20Authorities%26vs_k=1

Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by eMudhra was uncovered.
A security researcher demonstrated that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken due to an unprecedented error in their Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) in April 2025. This allows anyone to brute-force acquire these private keys within seconds. For more information, see eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise (https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/) and the Cisco Talos blog post Compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates (https://blog.talosintelligence.com/compromised-intermediate-certificates/).
Important: If a product is not listed within this advisory, Cisco's review indicates that the product is not affected by this vulnerability.
This advisory will be updated as additional information becomes available.
This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-emudhra-info-ScS22A1r

🖥 Leader: A strong Iran is founded upon scientific and technological might

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, in a message addressed to elites and medalists in scientific and athletic competitions on the global stage, highlighted the unparalleled role of these young, high-achieving individuals—who bring honor to the nation in science and sports—in fostering hope, progress, and vitality within the country.

The Leader identified the act of elites pushing the boundaries of science as the key to making Iran ever stronger.
​
He emphasized that, within the framework of the overarching strategy Knowledge is Power, the country’s progress requires a profound and rapid scientific surge.
​
The Leader stressed that officials must not only provide the necessary infrastructure and conditions for this scientific leap but also make maximum use of the individual capabilities and collective wisdom of the elites.
​
At this critical juncture, Iran stands as a symbol of determination and hope. Talented and capable Iranian youth and intellectuals play an unparalleled role in shaping this hope, driving progress, and building a bright future, the Leader wrote in his message issued on Monday.
​
But excellence is not confined to science, technology, sports, or professional skills. Any positive and meaningful form of distinction can constitute excellence, he added.
​
"Today, we are witnessing the dedication of outstanding individuals who, with a broader vision, strive to uphold their country's flag. They are the elite of insight and jihad, Ayatollah Khamenei further wrote.
​
On the days coinciding with the martyrdom anniversary of Lady Fatima Zahra (pbuh), Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, issued a message addressed to Iran's elites, as well as its scientific and sports medalists, on Oct. 26, 2026. The full text of his message is as follows:
​
In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful
​
According to one of the narrations, these days coincide with the martyrdom anniversary of the Master and Lady of the women of Paradise, Lady Siddiqah Tahirah, Fatimah Zahra (pbuh). It’s remarkable that the exact time of her martyrdom remains unknown, just as the honorable resting place of that divine light is still hidden. Moreover, because of her exalted station, her true worth and status remain unknown and beyond human comprehension. She was an exemplary figure in terms of worship, servitude, and devotion to God. She was a supreme example in her uniquely close, all-encompassing companionship with the Noble Prophet (pbuh), and she was a valiant defender of the Wilayah [Guardianship] of the Commander of the Faithful [Imam Ali (pbuh)]. She was a paragon in acquiring and imparting knowledge, in situational astuteness and rising up for the truth, in standing firm, and in clarification.
​
She was a top role model in patience, sacrifice, selflessness, helping others without expectation, and showing compassion for others in society. She was an exemplar as a wife, mother, and in raising the children and line of the Infallible Imams (pbut), who are the leaders of humanity. She was a model in her endeavor and striving, selfless struggle, purity, moral refinement, piety, radiance, and spirituality. And in one word, she’s a role model for all believing men and women.
​
Among the shining virtues of a society based on the example of Lady Fatimah (pbuh) is that it lays out a roadmap for the revolutionary, Muslim nation of Iran for undertaking great social movements, being present in the fields and arenas of struggle and jihad, participating in popular movements, and even aspiring to achieve progress in the sciences and serve others with humility without expecti . . .
